text:
Ava (Marketing): quick request 5 11 1 Need a compact micro-bench hero + webinar frame for next Tue. Core objective: benchmark credibility + clear inbound routing CTA.
Tom (Design): noted. Deliverables?
Ava (Marketing): hero static 1200x628, webinar frame 1920x1080 with 150px title-safe, 1:1 gif (1080x1080, ~3s loop), slide template (16:9 Figma). Also logo-left and centered variants for social.
Priya (Creative Ops): tag legal for benchmark claims and L10n for EN/ES/FR placeholders. Leave extra width for DE strings.
AssetsBot: export checklist: PNG @2x, SVG icons, GIF optimized (gifsicle --optimize=3), accessibility: text contrast >=4.5:1. Provide alt text.
Liam (Growth): two CTA options: "View results" / "Reserve a seat". Will A/B test. Animated CTA pulse for gif please.
Tom (Design): style direction: data-forward (sparklines + metric pills) + subtle mascot accent. Mock Thursday EOD, final Monday AM PST. Will upload to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/microbench-pack (frames: "hero-micro-v1", "webinar-frame-v1").
Ava (Marketing): timeline confirmed. Priya will coordinate L10n and legal review once WIP is uploaded. Thanks all :thumbsup:
